platformRules: Include the official Workflows shutdown notice: March 31, 2027, with workflow data deletion announced for April 30, 2027. Record the retrieval date and require a current lifecycle review before adoption.
Distinguish Workflows from Pipedream Connect; Connect is not a replacement workflow runtime and is explicitly unaffected by the notice.
Use this target for review of an existing workflow; do not promise new Workflows signups or new product features. Preserve the target without silently rerouting it.
Describe the trigger, step inputs and outputs, connected-account ownership and environment requirements without credentials.
Define bounded retry, deduplication and partial-side-effect recovery as requirements to verify against the existing account. Do not assert plan limits from historical forum posts.
Provide a manual export and migration handover checklist with a named owner. Never execute, deploy, delete, migrate or export a workflow automatically.
